{'0': 'With the conclusion of the "Surprise and shine" September event, Apple has today released the RC (release candidate) versions of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27 and other systems.'}

{'1': 'RC versions such as iPadOS 27 are available for testing starting today'}

{'2': 'Major software updates from Apple for iPhone, iPad, Mac and other devices are about to arrive.'}

{'3': 'iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, tvOS 27 and visionOS 27 will be officially pushed to all users next Monday (September 14).'}

{'4': 'After a summer of beta testing, Apple has today begun pushing the RC versions of the above updates to users.'}

{'5': 'Developers and public beta testers can install RC systems such as iPadOS 27 through the "Software Update" screen in "Settings".'}

{'6': 'The release candidate (RC) is generally considered the final version of the software and is released directly to all users. However, if Apple discovers any major issues that need to be fixed, we may see an RC 2 release very soon.'}

{'7': 'Apple typically releases the RC versions of its major software immediately after its annual iPhone launch event, and this practice has become standard.'}

{'8': 'The reason for this practice is that not all new features are usually announced at WWDC; some are only revealed at the September event. For example, Apple today announced some watchOS 27 features at its Apple Watch hardware launch event that were not mentioned at WWDC in June, and these features are now included in the watchOS 27 RC.'}

{'9': "Have you spotted any new features in Apple's RC version? Feel free to share with us in the comments section."}

{'10': 'For more coverage of Apple events, you can visit our dedicated event coverage hub.'}
